single.protocol: Two independently generated single motions conditioned on re-annotated per-person texts are concatenated and evaluated by the two-person InterCLIP evaluator. Not HumanML3D single-person evaluator.

two_person.protocol: InterHuman test set, two-person synthesis; per-person plus global interactive text for FreeMotion; InterCLIP paired-motion evaluator.

shared.paper_vs_code_difference: tools/eval.py repeats all metrics including MM20x, paper Table1 specifies MM5x
shared.InterGen_star_is_not_native_checkpoint: Main section5.2: modified InterGen cross-attention output dropout10%, retrained with per-person texts; native released checkpoint is not this baseline.
shared.SA_vs_CA_is_substantive: Supplementary section2.2/Table1: CA FID7.03 vs SA6.74.

official_metric_implementation.embedding: 512-d InterCLIP normalized text/motion features multiplied by learned latent_scale; physical motions [B,T,2,262], last4 contacts removed per actor before encoding
official_metric_implementation.FID: Multiply motion features by6; means and sample covariances; Frechet distance with scipy.linalg.sqrtm(C_real C_gen).
official_metric_implementation.R_Precision: Within96-candidate batches, Euclidean text-to-motion distances; cumulative diagonal matches top1,2,3. Apply same length sorting to both.
official_metric_implementation.MM_Distance: Mean Euclidean paired text/motion feature distance; no factor6.
official_metric_implementation.Diversity: Two sets of300 indices without replacement, average norm(6*(f_i-f_j)/2).
official_metric_implementation.Multimodality: 100 texts x30 motions,10 repeat-index pairs without replacement, mean motion feature distance; no factor6 or divisor2.
